name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-marmiton
description: Search Marmiton recipes, read ingredients and steps, and scale quantities to any number of servings. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: MARMITON_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent sent to Marmiton.

environmentVariables.name: MARMITON_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1000, floor 500.

environmentVariables.name: MARMITON_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
